description: Look up international country calling codes by free text, ISO code, dial code, or region. Optionally return reviewed, source-linked dialing examples. This tool does not verify live subscriber numbers.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, such as GB or GBR.

dialCode.description: Calling code with or without plus sign, such as +44 or 44.

includeExamples.description: When true, include reviewed safe mobile/landline patterns, transformation rules, source URLs, and lastVerified metadata.

limit.description: Maximum number of countries to return.

q.description: Free-text search, such as "United Kingdom", "London", or "AUS".

name: lookup_country_calling_code
title: Lookup Country Calling Code
